theory: An experiment is a set of ordered attempts over identified statements under identified code, prompts, budgets, and toolchains. Scoreboards summarize recomputable recorded outcomes, and pooling is permitted only when the conditions and content support comparison.
instead_of: Pool every result with the same model label or trust a saved solve-rate field; this model binds the procedure and rebuilds the aggregate from rows and their evidence.

absorption.rationale: Selection, repetition, and ordered worker completion have clear extension points, but making staged false statements first-class requires changing the current explicit fallback to batch and its paired limits.

world_mapping.rationale: Condition, Scoreboard, rows, automation tiers, active corpus identities, and canonical review map directly to experimental units and what a headline may claim.

abstraction.rationale: Selection and conservative source identity are shared below execution; aggregation reads records and represents missing measurements separately from observed zeros.

justification.rationale: The source denylist explains both false reuse and needless invalidation, and the runner explains why concurrent completions must publish a contiguous ordered prefix.

honest_limits.rationale: Unreviewed entries do not enter a headline; absent costs and empty denominators remain explicit, and complete tactic records are required before an entry can claim an automation tier.

rehearsals.requirement: Increase workers while preserving the same interrupted-run record semantics.
rehearsals.why: Jobs have stable slots and only the completed contiguous prefix is written.

rehearsals.requirement: Add a report over saved boards without changing experimental behavior.
rehearsals.why: Read-only reporting and run-source identity are separate, with report exclusions explicitly represented.

rehearsals.requirement: Evaluate false twins through the staged workflow rather than its batch fallback.
rehearsals.why: The current job mode and twin-specific budgets are deliberately batch-shaped because staged unverified results are graded partial.
